assumptions: The claim count is fixed before dealing and independent of the actor hand.
The actor plays only legal cards whenever enough are available, otherwise bluffs.
The behavior description contains no additional information about the hand.
The utility is the immediate opponent elimination probability minus self elimination probability; passing has utility zero.
interpretation: Agreement with a reference policy under these synthetic assumptions, not optimal play in the unrestricted game.
caseExpansion: boards in request order, then gun 0..5, then repeatIndex 0..repeats-1
seed: run seed plus the zero-based expanded case ordinal
